reviewer: root coordinator, post-arm independent pixel review

reference.role: general adult fictional subject appearance continuity only
reference.observable_scope: Long center-parted dark wavy hair and broad face-and-brow cues remain visually continuous across the five renders.
non_claims: no same-person or biometric identity claim
no attractiveness, personality, health, or status inference

aggregate.suite_rule: All five arms must pass all five gates.

vo_luxury_loud_original_code.evidence: An abstract crescent and stepped radial emblem is visible without readable brand text or a letter monogram.

vo_luxury_loud_prominence.evidence: The large central emblem remains the first-look focus at thumbnail scale.

vo_luxury_loud_coherent_repetition.evidence: The same radial code repeats at controlled smaller scales on corner plates, latch, and nearby plaques.

vo_luxury_loud_material_integration.evidence: Raised metal relief and smaller code plates align with leather panels, seams, straps, rivets, and latch hardware.

vo_luxury_loud_not_logo_or_clutter.evidence: No copied monogram or readable brand substitutes for the coherent object construction.

vo_luxury_bespoke_individual_pattern.evidence: Foreground draft sheets, measurement contours, and a matching record binder are visibly tied to the single client.

vo_luxury_bespoke_basted_correction.evidence: White basting lines cover the unfinished jacket while the cutter actively adjusts the shoulder.

vo_luxury_bespoke_hand_canvas.evidence: Only the exterior jacket and ordinary lapel facing are readable; exposed canvas or an unmistakable internal pad-stitch field is absent.

vo_luxury_bespoke_record_continuity.evidence: The open binder shows jacket diagrams, measurement-like notes, and material swatches linked by a repeated marker.

vo_luxury_bespoke_not_mtm_or_portrait.evidence: At thumbnail scale the scene reads as active one-client drafting and fitting, not a finished suit portrait.

vo_luxury_service_response.evidence: One client points to the damaged case while one gloved advisor responds at that object.

vo_luxury_service_curated_few.evidence: Exactly three large material swatches remain distinct on a compact tray at thumbnail scale.

vo_luxury_service_careful_handling.evidence: Both gloved hands align and inspect the rolled map and leather case.

vo_luxury_service_aftercare.evidence: The blank notebook and pen carry no repair diagram, maintenance step, linked sample, or other visible aftercare function.

vo_luxury_service_not_room_or_champagne.evidence: The advisor-client action dominates; the polished room and storm view remain secondary.

vo_luxury_jewelry_matched_stones.evidence: A deliberate blue-green graduated sequence is visible on the brooch and ordered tray.

vo_luxury_jewelry_setting_contact.evidence: The native detail shows silver-toned rims and small prong or bead contacts holding individual stones.

vo_luxury_jewelry_metal_support.evidence: A continuous spiral gallery and pavé-bearing ribs support the layout.

vo_luxury_jewelry_integrated_design.evidence: At thumbnail scale the stones and metal read as one original spiral-wave brooch.

vo_luxury_jewelry_not_sparkle_or_price.evidence: Mechanical setting structure, rather than loose sparkle or a value claim, carries the meaning.

vo_luxury_couture_individual_toile.evidence: The single client wears a cream unfinished toile with basting, pins, and exposed seam allowances.

vo_luxury_couture_live_correction.evidence: Two artisans actively work at the worn toile with pins, loose threads, and an opened side seam.

vo_luxury_couture_internal_layers.evidence: The open panel exposes a large rectangular boning and support grid.

vo_luxury_couture_hand_finish.evidence: An artisan pinches the attachment edge and applies a small hand tool directly at the open seam.

vo_luxury_couture_not_gown_only.evidence: At thumbnail scale the two artisans, unfinished edges, and exposed support dominate over glamour posing.

evidence_boundary: Prompt and render-request audits prove contract and byte preservation, not pixels. This coordinator review is a pixel observation, not a user aesthetic judgment.
